services.private_aviation_desc: Direct tarmac and FBO terminal transfers connecting private jet charters with executive destinations.
services.interstate_desc: Long-distance and interstate private chauffeur travel between major cities and regional centres.

corporate_section.title: Tailored for Executive Assistants & Corporate Leaders
corporate_section.subtitle: Streamlined travel management designed to eliminate stress for travel coordinators, executive assistants, and business delegates.
corporate_section.feature1_desc: Centralized corporate billing with flexible payment terms, clear receipting, and detailed monthly statement reports.
corporate_section.feature2_desc: Priority dispatch contact and rapid itinerary confirmations to handle last-minute schedule adjustments seamlessly.
corporate_section.feature3_desc: Chauffeur name, contact number, vehicle model, and registration sent ahead of time for smooth coordination.
corporate_section.feature4_desc: Commercial flights and private tail numbers are monitored live. We adjust pickup times for delays automatically.
corporate_section.feature5_desc: Professional chauffeurs waiting inside arrivals with a digital name board, ready to assist with luggage.
corporate_section.feature6_desc: A single reliable partner for your executive transport across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and Canberra.

why_choose_us.subtitle: Professional Standards & Reliability
why_choose_us.title: Why Choose Us?
why_choose_us.lead: We support corporate executives, travel managers, and private clients with dependable dispatch, pristine vehicles, and attentive service across Australia.
why_choose_us.punctuality_desc: We monitor flight arrival schedules in real time and account for traffic conditions so your chauffeur is positioned and ready before you step out.
why_choose_us.safety_desc: Travel with complete peace of mind. Our licensed chauffeurs provide discreet, confidential, and safe travel tailored for corporate executives and private guests.
why_choose_us.chauffeurs_desc: Every chauffeur is background-checked, professionally accredited, and trained in executive etiquette and defensive driving.
why_choose_us.fleet_desc: Select from a pristine fleet of modern luxury sedans, SUVs, and executive vans equipped with complimentary premium amenities.

testimonials.title: Client Reviews
testimonials.subtitle: Feedback from executive assistants, travel managers, and corporate leaders who rely on our services across Australia.
testimonials.quote1: Elite Cars Australia manages our executive airport transfers and board meeting itineraries in Sydney and Melbourne. Drivers are consistently punctual, courteous, and communicate in advance. An indispensable partner for our corporate travel.
testimonials.quote2: Excellent airport transfer service. The chauffeur monitored our delayed flight from Singapore and was waiting inside arrivals with a name board. Clean Mercedes S-Class, smooth drive, and effortless monthly invoicing.
testimonials.quote3: We reserved multiple Mercedes V-Class vehicles for keynote speakers across a 3-day conference. Flawless dispatch coordination, polite drivers, and great feedback from all our international delegates.
testimonials.quote4: Reliable tarmac and FBO transfers for our private charter guests in Sydney and the Gold Coast. Discretion, vehicle condition, and driver professionalism are always top-tier.
